name: Eduard Fernández
bio: Eduard Fernández is a Spanish actor born on 25 August 1964 in Barcelona, Catalonia. He began his career in theatre and spent several years with the company Els Joglars before establishing himself in film and television. His notable screen credits include Fausto 5.0, In the City, Biutiful, The Skin I Live In, A Perfect Day, The Man with a Thousand Faces, While at War and the series 30 Coins. Fernández has received several Goya Awards for both leading and supporting performances.
